title: Your Family Will Adore These Smart String Lights
gist: This is a Wired deal post: Govee Christmas Lights 2, the budget pick in Wired's smart Christmas lights guide, are 25% off, at $75 instead of $100 on Amazon, with savings from $25 on the 66-foot length up to $100 on the 328-foot length. The reviewer highlights IP67 weatherproofing, Matter support and an app with more than 100 effect presets that can also generate effects.

insights.claim: Govee Christmas Lights 2 are 25% off, listed at $75 instead of $100 on Amazon. The savings run from $25 off the 66-foot length to $100 off the 328-foot length, the lowest prices the reviewer has seen since Black Friday last year.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Smart-lighting holiday discounting has started before November.
insights.quote: I haven’t seen them priced this low since Black Friday last year.

insights.claim: The lights are IP67 rated and can withstand extreme temperatures. They connect over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi to the Govee app or to smart-home ecosystems via Matter, and the app maps the lights with the phone camera to offer more than 100 animated presets plus effects it generates from the user's interests.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Matter support and software features set budget smart lighting apart more than the hardware does.
insights.quote: There are well over 100 presets to choose from, but you can also have the app generate effects for you based on your interests.

insights.claim: The reviewer has used the lights outdoors for a couple of years and they are still going strong, and Govee's app is described as perhaps the most feature-packed in smart lighting.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Long-term reliability and app depth are Govee's competitive pitch.
